description: ¡Hola! Somos SAKUGA, un equipo de estudiantes del ITFAM apasionados por la tecnología y la programación. Estamos participando por primera vez en el NASA Space.
summary: Autonomous Health Monitoring & Countermeasures for Deep Space Missions
details:
OVERVIEW & HOW IT WORKS

ASTRA HEALTH is an autonomous, offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) designed to monitor astronaut physiological and cognitive health during long-duration deep-space missions (such as transit to Mars), where Earth-to-crew communication delays reach 4 to over 24 minutes each way or suffer prolonged blackouts. Because real-time consultation with flight surgeons is impossible under high latency, ASTRA HEALTH executes 100% of its processing locally in the spacecraft terminal browser with zero external backend servers:

1. Live Telemetry Module: Tracks 10 vital and environmental parameters every 3 seconds—Heart Rate (HR), SpO2, Body Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Sleep Quality, Fatigue, Stress, Radiation Dose Rate, Cumulative Radiation Dose, and Cabin CO2—with real-time sparklines, interactive historical charts, and color-coded operational triage (Green = Nominal, Yellow = Warning, Red = Critical).

2. Autonomous Diagnostics Engine (anomalyEngine.ts): A deterministic TypeScript rule engine running 10 local validation rules that detect single-parameter threshold breaches and multi-variable compound risks (Fatigue + Stress; Radiation Dose Rate + Cumulative Dose). It implements a 2-minute alert deduplication window to prevent alarm fatigue and automatically resolves alerts once vitals normalize.

3. Countermeasures Protocol Matrix: Maps active alerts to 13 structured biomechanical and operational response protocols prioritized by severity, allowing crew members to log completed actions under clear decision-support disclaimers.

4. Cognitive & Behavioral Assessment: Integrates a 2-minute Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) reaction-time test measuring accuracy, anticipations, omissions, median/mean reaction time, and variability against an individualized baseline (calibrated after 3 sessions), paired with a 3-question wellness check-in (mood, stress, fatigue).

5. Emergency Mission Simulator: Features 5 interactive anomaly scenarios (Solar Storm, Fatigue, Sleep Deprivation, High Cabin CO2, and Low Oxygen) that demonstrate the complete end-to-end pipeline from sensor drift to alert generation, countermeasure execution, and CSV data export.

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

ASTRA HEALTH shifts critical medical decision support directly into the hands of the crew, ensuring total healthcare independence during deep-space communication blackouts. Beyond multi-year Mars missions, its modular offline-first architecture scales seamlessly to long-term lunar habitats (Artemis program), orbital stations, and isolated extreme environments on Earth such as polar research outposts and submarine operations.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE STACK

Built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS 3, Recharts 2, Lucide React, and React Router v6. Full offline persistence and asset caching are powered by vite-plugin-pwa (Workbox) and browser LocalStorage.

CREATIVITY & DESIGN CONSIDERATIONS

Sakuga Team prioritized zero-server resilience, human-factors usability (mitigating alarm fatigue via deduplication and instant visual triage), individualized cognitive baselines rather than static population averages, and strict medical ethics—explicitly framing all outputs as operational decision support rather than clinical diagnosis, alongside privacy-by-design local data storage.
